args: C="$HOME/.openclaw/state/orama-root.cache"; W="$(cat "$C" 2>/dev/null)"; [ -f "$W/scripts/exa/exa-mcp-wrapper.sh" ] || W=""; if [ -z "$W" ]; then for D in "$PWD/orama-system" "$PWD/../orama-system" "$PWD/../../orama-system"; do R="$(cd "$D" 2>/dev/null && pwd)"; if [ -n "$R" ] && [ -f "$R/scripts/exa/exa-mcp-wrapper.sh" ]; then W="$R"; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$W" ]; then W="$(find "$HOME" -maxdepth 4 -type d -name orama-system 2>/dev/null | while read -r D; do [ -f "$D/scripts/exa/exa-mcp-wrapper.sh" ] && { echo "$D"; break; }; done)"; fi; [ -n "$W" ] || { echo 'orama-system checkout not found' >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$W/scripts/exa/exa-mcp-wrapper.sh"
